business_problem: ALLO Fiber needed to centralize fragmented data from spreadsheets, APIs, and databases, remove the request-and-wait reporting cycle, and give teams faster answers about marketing, trouble tickets, and operational performance.
solution_summary: ALLO Fiber modernized its analytics environment around BigQuery and Looker so business teams could move from manually requested reports to governed self-service exploration. BigQuery serves as the centralized lakehouse and single source of truth for disconnected spreadsheets, API feeds, and operational databases, while LookML models business logic into reusable metrics. Looker provides the front door to that semantic layer, and ALLO is extending it with Gemini Enterprise and Model Context Protocol-based conversational analytics so teams can ask complex questions in plain language. The company is also building integrated marketing dashboards that join Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, sales, and NPS data, creating a stable analytics foundation while ALLO replaces or integrates dozens of legacy systems.

solution_components.role: Centralizes data from spreadsheets, APIs, and operational databases into a single analytics lakehouse.

solution_components.name: Looker
solution_components.role: Presents governed metrics and dashboards so business teams can answer questions without custom report requests.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise
solution_components.role: Adds conversational analytics capabilities that let employees investigate complex issues through natural-language prompts.

solution_components.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
solution_components.role: Connects conversational analytics tools to ALLO Fiber's governed data and semantic models.

data_flow: Disparate data from spreadsheets, APIs, advertising systems, sales systems, and operational databases is consolidated in BigQuery and modeled in Looker. Gemini Enterprise and MCP then let employees query those governed datasets conversationally, with results flowing back into marketing and operations decisions.
business_outcome: ALLO Fiber cut complex-analysis time from hours to minutes, democratized access to operational and marketing data, and created an analytics foundation that can stay stable while the company modernizes a large number of legacy systems.
